name: XXL-JOB Console
description: Manage XXL-JOB reports, jobs, logs, executors and users in DBX.
releaseNotes: Fix HTTP 400 when listing executors on Admin 3.1.0 by sending required empty appname/title filters. Emit plugin + artifacts release metadata for DBX Store scanning and add Windows/Linux CI with native package handshake checks.
